title: Technical & Academic Writing
subtitle: Find, cite and write clearly, with honest sources and useful figures
audience_line: Students, researchers and engineers who write reports and papers
overview: This free course helps participants write technical and academic documents that are clear, honest and well sourced. They manage references with Zotero, read and summarise papers, learn the rules of publication ethics and how to avoid plagiarism, then apply the principles of clear, precise and concise writing, use the passive voice deliberately, and design figures that support the text. The course closes with a final project in which each participant writes a short paper section with citations and a figure and reviews a peer's work.

facts.label: Audience
facts.value: Students, researchers and engineers who write reports and papers

facts.label: Prerequisites
facts.value: None. Participants bring a writing project of their own if they have one

facts.label: Duration
facts.value: 18 h: 15 h of chapters + 3 h buffer

facts.label: Format
facts.value: Free course: short lectures, each followed by writing exercises and peer feedback

facts.label: Lab environment
facts.value: One laptop per participant with Zotero 7 and its word-processor plugin, a word processor, a spreadsheet or Python (Matplotlib); no account or cost

facts.label: Assessment
facts.value: Exercises reviewed in each phase and a final paper section reviewed by a peer; certificate of completion for participants who complete both

facts.label: Outcome
facts.value: Participants can manage and cite sources with Zotero, summarise papers, avoid plagiarism, and write clear sections with effective figures

phases.name: Sources & Ethics
phases.focus: Zotero, reading and summarising papers, publication ethics, plagiarism
phases.intro: Participants build a reference library in Zotero and cite from it, learn to read and summarise papers efficiently, and study publication ethics and how to avoid plagiarism. Validated exercise: a one-page summary of a paper with correctly generated citations.

phases.name: Writing & Figures
phases.focus: Clarity, precision, concision, voice and style, figures
phases.intro: Participants apply the rules of academic writing for clarity, precision and concision, choose between active and passive voice on purpose, and design figures that make one point each. Validated exercise: a paragraph rewritten for clarity and a figure redesigned from a cluttered original.

chapters.title: Writing Rules
chapters.content: Academic writing rules; clarity, precision, concision

phases.name: Final Project
phases.focus: A short paper section, written and peer-reviewed
phases.intro: Each participant writes a short section of a paper or report, reusing the course exercises, and reviews a peer's section.

chapters.title: Write
chapters.content: A short paper section with Zotero citations and a figure

chapters.title: Peer Review
chapters.content: Review a peer's section, revise one's own; feedback

project.title: Paper Section with Peer Review
project.brief: A short paper or report section with citations managed in Zotero and one figure, reviewed by a peer and revised.
project.stack: Zotero 7 with its word-processor plugin, a word processor, a spreadsheet or Python (Matplotlib)
